Product Case Study — HR Analytics Tool

A drag-and-drop dashboard that turns any HR spreadsheet into live analytics

Employee Performance Ledger is a self-built, browser-based dashboard — no Power BI, no Tableau, no chart library. Drop in any Excel or CSV of employee records and every KPI, chart, and filter recalculates instantly, client-side.

01 — The Idea

HR teams shouldn't need a BI license to see their own data

Most HR reporting lives in static Excel exports that go stale the moment someone asks a follow-up question. I built a lightweight web tool that opens with a realistic sample dataset out of the box, so anyone can explore it immediately — then accepts a real company file and re-renders every chart from that data, with zero configuration.

Employee Performance Ledger — opens with a working 60-record sample, fully interactive from the first load
02 — What It Does

Five KPIs, five charts, one searchable directory — all recomputed live

Ingestion
Drag-and-drop or file-picker upload for .xlsx / .csv — no template required
KPIs
Headcount, avg. salary, attendance, work progress, promotion eligibility
Charts
Department bar chart, gender donut, salary ranking, hiring trend, tenure vs. performance scatter
Filtering
Multi-select on Department, Team, Location, Employment Type, Gender, Status
Timeline
Joining-date range picker with 6M / 1Y / 3Y / All quick filters
Directory
Scrollable, sortable employee table that reflects every active filter in real time
Every row in the directory updates the instant a filter changes — no page reload, no server round-trip
03 — Real-World Test

Same tool, zero code changes — 500 real employee records

To stress-test it beyond the sample data, I loaded a real June 2026 employee export covering 500 people across 10 departments and 10 cities. Every KPI card, chart, and the directory table recalculated instantly on upload.

June 2026 Employee Database — 500 rows, recomputed on upload with no manual remapping
04 — Filtering In Action

Multi-select filters, applied and reflected live

Department, Location, and Status all support multi-select checkboxes. Selecting a combination narrows every chart and the directory table simultaneously.

Department filter — multi-select checklist
Work Location filter — 10 cities available
Status filter — Active / On Leave / Resigned
05 — Drill-Down

From 500 to 51 to 136 — filters compose, KPIs stay accurate

Selecting Customer Support alone narrows the whole dashboard to 51 employees. Adding Admin and Finance brings it to 136 — every KPI, chart, and directory row updates to match, so HR can answer a follow-up question in seconds instead of rebuilding a pivot table.

1 department selected → 51 of 500 employees
3 departments selected → 136 of 500 employees

Promotion pipeline

07 — Built With

No frameworks, no chart libraries — just the browser

Every chart on this page is rendered as inline SVG, computed directly from whatever file is loaded. That keeps the tool dependency-free, fast to load, and easy for a client to self-host or embed anywhere.
